Hi Hanna — thanks, and great to meet you. Short answers below plus a checklist to speed up PO activation.

Checklist (documents that will enable PO activation):
- Official EU VAT certificate (national tax authority PDF) — required
- Company registration extract (chamber of commerce / Bolagsverket) — required
- Bank details (IBAN, BIC, account name) + remit instruction — required for payments setup
- Sample invoice showing VAT fields / invoice numbering — required for mapping
- Completed Redwood Supplier Onboarding Form (link below) — required
- Tax residency / W-8BEN-E: Redwood is US-headquartered; for non-US entities we request a signed W-8BEN-E or equivalent tax residency attestation for US tax purposes. If you prefer, provide a corporate tax residency letter from your accountant.

PO/invoice handling notes:
- Reverse-charge: we can support reverse-charge at invoice reconciliation if the supplier indicates VAT-exempt supply. Please include a visible VAT flag and the VAT reg no on every invoice. We will route invoices to Accounts Payable with the reverse-charge checkbox and post accordingly.
- PO mapping: provide the billing address and the remit-to account exactly as it should appear on the PO (we don't change vendor-supplied remit names).
- Timeline: once we receive all required documents and the completed onboarding form, PO activation typically takes 3-5 business days. If legal/tax needs to review the VAT cert for reverse-charge confirmation that can add 2-3 business days.

Action items for you:
1) Upload VAT cert + sample invoice + company extract to the Drive link (or reply with attachments).
2) Fill the onboarding form: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_onboarding

I'll open the vendor record in our procurement tool and start the PO request once I have the docs. Looping in Laura (AP) and Karthik (tax) for visibility.

Thanks — Irene
